facets.detail: Dispatch order is load-bearing, not stylistic. Everything past the subcommand block is treated as a flag-driven invocation (--daemon / --no-daemon / --probe / the default stdio MCP reader), and the unknown-command guard deliberately rejects only a first arg that does NOT start with '-'. So any bare flag falls through and BOOTS THE MCP READER, which then sits waiting for protocol traffic that never arrives — this is exactly how `coldstart --version` came to hang. Fixed 2026-07-24 by handling --version/-v and --help/-h first, by exact match, before any other branch; a new flag that should exit must be added there, not to the guard.
